problem_type: Approved duration loses its executable control identity
symptom: Approved 6/7/8-second imported shots retain the template default of five seconds.
direct_cause: Storyboard emits duration while the declared imported control uses the importer-defined comfy_duration key; planning only recognizes bare duration.
class_root: Duration-role projection is not shared between intent, recommendation and executable parameter construction.
affected_population: Old nodes with contradictory semantic/wire values
internal_only_reason: Internal declared-control projection defect. Existing parameter-constraint and importer owners define execution keys and legal ranges; no external API or runtime was changed.
invariants: Requested duration reaches its declared execution key before defaults apply.
Contradictory explicit values are rejected without guessing.
No model name, vendor name, graph node ID or translated label decides duration.

door_reduction.why_not: Existing surfaces remain; the shared duration-role boundary eliminates divergent interpretation without deleting supported callers.

generality_proof: The existing paramConstraints owner handles canonical duration and the importer-defined comfy_duration key for all models using those declared roles. Planner, materialization and request construction reuse it.

shared_boundaries.responsibility: Place semantic duration into the declared canonical/import-namespaced control and reject contradictory explicit values.

same_class_entry_points.evidence: Translation precedes default composition and valid overrides.
Conflicting historical metadata is rejected before any provider submission.
Recommendation recognizes the same declared role instead of only the bare key.
The existing review-side resolver writes the declared duration key and clears old duration overrides when accepting split/merge proposals.

recurrence.reason: The same semantic/wire mismatch spans providers, imported graphs and multiple authoring/submission paths.
same_class_scan: Read importer scalar paramKey naming, NUMERIC_LABEL and both actual imported bindings
Read storyboard duration writer, plannedNodeMeta, recommendation, paramConstraints and catalogTaskActions
Generated pre-change maps for materialization/request/range/option helpers

prevention.invariant: One shared declared-role placement is used for planned intent and runtime request parameters.
prevention.failure_mode: Ambiguous or conflicting explicit durations throw a code-shaped error before submission. No resubmission or project rewrite.
prevention.strategy: Reuse paramConstraints and its existing value-validation owner; replace bare-key-only duration role lookups.

legacy_paths.rationale: Bare-key-only role lookup is replaced in the same implementation; no per-model compatibility fallback remains.

dependency_lifecycle.rationale: Internal domain parameter projection using existing constraints; no dependency/runtime upgrade.

migration: Do not rewrite user graphs or old project values. Conflicting explicit legacy fields require correction rather than an inferred winner.
residual_risks: No new inference authorized; real newly generated clip timing remains paid-verification-excluded.
Only established canonical and importer-defined duration keys are recognized; unnamed graph numeric values are not guessed.
